hook: The Natural Formula That Supports Prostate Health
claim: FlowForce Max is a prostate formula that, unusually, blames prostate and urinary problems on fungal infection. The seller says it helps keep the bladder and urinary tract safe from fungi.
story: Its reference list includes case reports of Candida prostatitis and news stories about fungi in sink drains. Fungal prostatitis does exist, but it is rare and mostly seen in people with weakened immune systems; it isn't a common cause of an enlarged prostate.
ing_note: The label also lists magnesium stearate (a manufacturing flow agent). Amounts are not disclosed.
price_note: FlowForce Max is sold as 1, 3 or 6 bottles with free shipping on every order; totals appear on the order page.
checks: An enlarged prostate (BPH) is caused by hormone-driven growth with age, not by fungus in most men.
Oregano extract kills fungi in lab tests, but there's no evidence it treats urinary or prostate infections.
Muira puama is a Brazilian 'libido' herb with very limited human research.
Saw palmetto did no better than placebo in the largest prostate trials.
cons: Fungus theory of prostate problems isn't supported
verdict: FlowForce Max sells an unusual fungal theory of prostate trouble that doesn't match medical understanding. If you have urinary symptoms, especially pain, fever or blood in the urine, see a doctor: infections need proper diagnosis and treatment, and BPH has effective medicines.
